title: Pixtt Riel Tavas
summary: Control unstable constructs as Riel Tavas locks the room and increases her offensive pressure.
overview: Control unstable constructs as Riel Tavas locks the room and increases her offensive pressure.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Use controlled crowd control on unstable constructs rather than killing them beside the raid.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The room seals at 90% health. At 50%, she gains flurry and an additional timed attack.
Construct spawning resumes at 30%, becomes faster and larger at lower health, and is joined by a venom cycle below 25%.
Unstable constructs explode when killed. A construct observed mezzed begins a 30-second despawn timer while Riel remains alive.
The 10% stage further strengthens flurry; a wipe reset restores health and unlocks the room.

notes: Approval E331. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
